name: Down Stretch
stable: The long arc from knees to head
mobile: Shoulders; front of the hips opens
summary: Kneeling with the feet against the shoulder rests and hands on the footbar, the hips press forward and the chest lifts into a long back bend that holds as the carriage moves out and in.
steps: Kneel on the carriage, feet against the shoulder rests, hands on the footbar.
Press the hips forward and lift the breastbone into a long arc.
Breathe in to push the carriage back, keeping the arc.
Breathe out to bring it home, chest lifting up and through the arms.

layers.title: Hold the shape
layers.text: Hips forward, chest open, carriage still.

layers.title: Press out and in
layers.text: The back bend holds as the carriage moves a short way.

layers.title: Lift higher on the return
layers.text: Chest and eyes lift a little more each time the carriage comes home.

cues:
Lift up out of the lower back; think length, then arch.
Thighs stay pressing forward.
Shoulders slide down the back.
